verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. The pack only documents subscription payment plans and recurring payment links. These are recurring billing features, not user-configurable automations or agentic workflows that run autonomously in the background. No evidence shows schedulers, workflow rules, or agent-driven background tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
